record.title: VICE-compatible AM29F040B timing and safe expansion write-back
record.body: Flash040Core exposes AdvanceCycles and the VIC-20 machine clock advances it. TYPE_B timeout/sector/chip budgets, busy reads, cancel, suspend, and resume are deterministic. Expansion-cart dirty payloads remain type-correct; host detach uses a same-directory temporary file and atomic replacement.
